fact_check.claim: A Transportation Services survey reported by the Sun in 2007 found 1.4% of undergraduates biked to campus and 71% walked
fact_check.note: Article gives 1.4 percent bike and 71 percent walk, citing a Transportation Services survey. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Many riders stop at the first snow, but some keep going
fact_check.note: Article says 'many bikers put a hold on their cycling at the first sign of snow'. 'for years' rests on one 2007 piece plus the 2023 piece, a loose phrase.

fact_check.claim: Ithaca and Cornell's campus pose challenges to bikers because of cold climate and hilly terrain
fact_check.note: Sun 2023: 'Between its cold climate and hilly terrain, Ithaca and Cornell's campus pose challenges to bikers.'

fact_check.claim: In 2007 riders told the Sun they sometimes have to swerve out of the bike lane to avoid danger because of plowed snow and pothole covers
fact_check.note: Rider quote 'you have to swerve out of the bike lane to avoid danger'; crews 'leave pot hole covers in bike lane'. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Cornell's bicycle specialist recommended a second bike for winter since salt, snow and ice wear down a year-round bike
fact_check.note: Lois Chaplin recommended a second bike; wear from snow, ice and salt.

fact_check.claim: The bicycle specialist recommended washing and lubricating the chain after every ride once roads are salted
fact_check.note: Source says 'Wash and re-lube after every ride, especially once the roads are being salted' and never mentions a chain. The quote is followed by 'he recommended' although Chaplin is 'she', so the speaker is unclear.

fact_check.claim: One rider in that article said good brakes matter more than anything for stopping
fact_check.note: Mike Wine said 'If you have good brakes, your stopping distance isn't too affected by weather conditions' and also stressed friction with brake pads. He did not say brakes matter more than anything.

fact_check.claim: Hat or headband under the helmet, eye protection, synthetic or wool layers, no cotton, ski clothing works
fact_check.note: All in Chaplin's advice in the article.

fact_check.claim: Lois Chaplin told the Sun in 2007 that she stops biking when the temperature drops below 40 degrees
fact_check.note: Article: she gives up biking when 'the temperature drops below 40 degrees'. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Cornell says bicycles belong on streets, not sidewalks, and have the same rights to the road as other vehicles
fact_check.note: Both sentences present. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Cornell clears about 15 miles of roads, 61 miles of walkways and 114 acres of parking lots; page does not mention bike lanes
fact_check.note: Figures match; no bike lane mention; response depends on priority roads and walkways.

fact_check.claim: Report slippery spots on campus at 607-255-5322
fact_check.note: Number listed for unsafe or slippery conditions.

fact_check.claim: City of Ithaca: owners must keep sidewalks free of snow and ice; the city may clear and bill the owner (Feb 2026)
fact_check.note: Quoted rule and billing under City Code Chapter 178-3 confirmed.

fact_check.claim: Legal headlights and taillights at dusk or night, plus a bell or horn; a personal strobe is not a legal taillight
fact_check.note: All present. The sunset-time sentence from the earlier draft was removed (previous fix applied).

fact_check.claim: Registering a bike is free; Cornell asks you to register with it and your local municipality
fact_check.note: 'free of charge'; register with Cornell Commuter & Parking Services and the local municipality.

fact_check.claim: Bikes locked to railings, signposts or trees may be impounded
fact_check.note: Listed as impound reason.

fact_check.claim: Cornell says it has over 1,000 bike parking stations
fact_check.note: 'over 1,000 bike parking stations across campus'.

fact_check.claim: About seven miles of bike lanes plus two miles of shared paths
fact_check.note: Sun guest column: 'approximately seven miles of bike lanes, and two miles of shared paths on campus'.

fact_check.claim: Every TCAT bus has a front-mounted bike rack at no extra fare
fact_check.note: Page: every local TCAT bus has a front rack; no additional fare.

fact_check.claim: Cornell's biking page links to a Bike Walk Tompkins list of local shops
fact_check.note: Local Bike Shops section links to bikewalktompkins.org/bike-shops. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: First-year degree students get unlimited TCAT rides
fact_check.note: New students get OmniRide privileges for unlimited rides (expire Aug 31 for fall entrants, Dec 31 for spring entrants; article does not give the expiry, a minor omission).

fact_check.claim: Registered degree-program students who stay registered ride free after 6 p.m. weekdays and all weekend
fact_check.note: Matches; the page labels this group as enrolled a year or more, which the article omits. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: PhD students and graduate assistants get free OmniRide passes
fact_check.note: 'Registered Cornell PhD students and graduate assistants receive free TCAT OmniRide passes.'

fact_check.claim: OmniRide annual pass $200 per year
fact_check.note: '$200/year', prorated monthly.

fact_check.claim: Cash fare if your CU ID is not accepted: $1.50
fact_check.note: Page: if CU ID is not accepted you 'may need to pay the $1.50 fare with cash'. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Ithaca Bikeshare: $1.50 to unlock plus $0.25 per minute, $25 day pass, $60 monthly plan
fact_check.note: All prices match (plus tax).

fact_check.claim: Class 1 pedal-assist e-bikes, riders 16 or older
fact_check.note: Matches; page also requires parent or guardian consent for minors.

fact_check.claim: Trips that do not end in a hub carry a $1.50 convenience fee
fact_check.note: Confirmed. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Sun 2023: a student said it was too snowy for bikeshare; current prices are higher than the 2023 per-minute rate
fact_check.note: Chet Lukanic: 'a little too snowy at the moment'; 2023 rate was 15 cents per minute plus $1 unlock, so current $0.25 is higher.

fact_check.claim: Email help@ithacabikeshare.org about winter service; page does not say whether service pauses
fact_check.note: Email listed; no winter pause mentioned.

beats_top.why: The #1 result is a 2007 Sun news piece with dated survey numbers and no current rules, snow-clearing, TCAT costs or bikeshare info. Ours answers the question in the first paragraph and adds current official rules, costs and a bus backup plan.
changes: Fix the two overstated 2007 attributions (brakes, chain) so every claim matches the Sun piece.
Optionally add a sourced December sunset time or the TCAT expiry dates for first-year privileges.

fixes: Change 'One rider in that article said good brakes matter more than anything for stopping' to say Mike Wine told the Sun that with good brakes stopping distance is not much affected by weather, and that a winter bike needs good friction at the brake pads; source https://cornellsun.com/2007/11/12/cyclists-persevere-through-wintry-weather

In the Salt bullet, delete 'the chain' and the attribution to the bicycle specialist: say the Sun quotes advice to wash and re-lube after every ride, especially once roads are salted; source https://cornellsun.com/2007/11/12/cyclists-persevere-through-wintry-weather
